note: Reviewed curation overlay for the EthTotal target set. tools/ethtotal-inventory.py enumerates all 3333 theorems, tools/ethtotal-triage.py buckets every one of them and ranks candidates per file, and this file is the human decision on top: which theorems become 01e base entries, at what severity, under which ethereum-vuln-dataset label, with what audit-facing title. tools/ethtotal-build-map.py joins the three into theorem_map_ethtotal.json. Nothing here asserts proof status — lean_status comes only from lake exe speca-export.
label_note: `label` values are ethereum-vuln-dataset labels (the vocabulary in data/ethtotal_vulns_high.csv). EthTotal is an execution-layer accounting formalization, so its labels are the value-bearing EL surfaces (state-trie, transactions, evm, opcodes, gas, database, block-processing) plus the CL issuance surfaces for the withdrawal/mint results. Unlike the gasper labels, these have NO consensus-specs pyspec anchor, so `spec_reference` is honestly absent on these properties rather than pointed at a document that does not describe them.
covers_hint_note: covers_hint names execution-specs (EELS) level state operations and opcode names — generic protocol surfaces an auditor greps for, never a client's internal symbol. They are matching hints for `covers` resolution, not verified anchors.
severity_note: Severity is the Ethereum Foundation bug-bounty model (network-scale impact reachable remotely): CRITICAL = an implementation defect here breaks fund integrity or total-supply soundness at network scale; HIGH = it corrupts accounting/state for a value-bearing path; MEDIUM = it degrades the auditability or the record, without directly moving value. Severities are calibrated on the audit consequence, never tuned against a benchmark distribution.

supply-conservation.label: state-trie
supply-conservation.description: The supply/balance reconciliation identities: total supply is the sum over the live account set, and any transition reconciles exactly with its per-account deltas.

mint-burn-attribution.label: block-processing
mint-burn-attribution.description: Every supply change must be attributable to an explicit, sited mint or burn event — the accountability half of the model (SiteConfined / witness results).

value-transfer.label: transactions
value-transfer.description: Transfer, overdraft, self-transfer and stale-read behaviour: where a truncating subtraction or a re-read of a mutated balance creates value.

fee-accounting.label: gas
fee-accounting.description: Prepayment, escrow, refund/tip/burn settlement and the guards that make the split exact (the EIP-1559-shaped fee path).

account-lifecycle.label: opcodes
account-lifecycle.description: Account destruction, erasure, resurrection and write preconditions — SELFDESTRUCT and empty-account semantics.

state-persistence.label: state-trie
state-persistence.description: Storage support vs write set, default-value deletion, and the difference between writing a value and storing it.

arithmetic-representation.label: evm
arithmetic-representation.description: Representation limits: balance caps, saturating (monus) subtraction, carries/parity, quantization thresholds and unbounded growth.

audit-record.label: database
audit-record.description: The trace/log side: what a record must carry for an audit to be sound — ordering, polarity, sites, checksums, aggregation and normalization.

issuance-withdrawal.label: beacon-chain:withdrawal
issuance-withdrawal.description: Supply entering the execution layer: withdrawal credits as mints, and their quantization.

state-model.label: block-processing
state-model.description: The structural layer: ledger/finitary-support algebra, the derivation lemmas and the categorical repackaging of already-proved results. Real proof substance, but its audit surface is the results built on top of it.

curated.text: Total supply must reconcile exactly against the per-account balance deltas of a state transition
curated.assertion: L'.supply + sum(L.bal - L'.bal) over live = L.supply + sum(L'.bal - L.bal) over live

curated.text: Supply reconciliation must not depend on which covering account list the implementation enumerates
curated.assertion: any distinct list covering both supports yields the same reconciliation identity

curated.text: A transition that only debits accounts must reduce total supply by exactly the sum of those debits
curated.assertion: (forall a, L'.bal a <= L.bal a) -> L'.supply + sum(L.bal - L'.bal) = L.supply

curated.text: Supply monotonicity must be checked only over an account set that covers the whole balance support
curated.assertion: support-covering hypothesis is required for (forall a in live, L'.bal a <= L.bal a) -> L'.supply <= L.supply

curated.text: Every account balance increase must be attributable to a positive mint event recorded at a declared mint site
curated.assertion: bal increase and SiteConfined M B trace -> exists mint(d,v) in trace with v>0 and d in M

curated.text: Every account balance decrease must be attributable to a positive burn event recorded at a declared burn site
curated.assertion: bal decrease and SiteConfined M B trace -> exists burn(s,v) in trace with v>0 and s in B

curated.text: A transition that declares no mint site and no burn site must leave total supply unchanged
curated.assertion: SiteConfined [] [] trace -> L'.supply = L.supply

curated.text: Two event traces reporting the same state transition must agree on net minted minus burned
curated.assertion: both traces satisfy the accounting equation -> burned t + minted t' = burned t' + minted t

curated.text: No event in a burn-confined trace may carry a burn site other than the declared one
curated.assertion: SiteConfined M [x] trace -> forall e in trace, e.burnSite = none or e.burnSite = some x

curated.text: Total supply must not grow unless the trace contains an event whose minted amount is strictly positive
curated.assertion: all mint events zero -> minted trace = 0 -> supply cannot increase

curated.text: Transaction processing must conserve supply across prepayment, execution and refund/tip/burn settlement
curated.assertion: prepay P = R+T+B then settle -> L2.supply + burned = L0.supply + minted, confined to the declared sites

curated.text: The single admission check on prepayment plus value must be equivalent to the two staged balance guards
curated.assertion: P + value <= bal(sender) <-> P <= bal(sender) and value <= bal(sender) after prepay

curated.text: Refund, priority tip and base-fee burn must exactly partition the prepaid amount with no residue
curated.assertion: R + (T + B) = P, and settlement distributes exactly R, T, B from the escrowed P

curated.text: Fee settlement must never draw more from the escrowed prepayment than was actually escrowed
curated.assertion: escrow balance stays >= 0 without truncation across refund, tip and burn

curated.text: Any prepayment residue left in the fee escrow after settlement must be detected, not silently retained
curated.assertion: R + T + B < P -> escrow retains P - (R+T+B): a leak, not a balanced settlement

curated.text: Fee settlement must reject a distribution that exceeds the prepayment instead of overdrawing the escrow
curated.assertion: R + T + B > P is unrepresentable: the settlement must fail, not saturate

curated.text: Neither the gas-limit guard nor the base-fee guard may be dropped: each independently prevents a fee-path defect
curated.assertion: dropping either guard admits a settlement that violates the fee partition

curated.text: A self-transfer must not be implemented as debit-then-credit against a stale balance read
curated.assertion: credit computed from the pre-debit balance on a self-directed transfer increases supply

curated.text: A transfer implementation must be checked against the specification's neutrality requirement, not only against its own steps
curated.assertion: the naive stepwise transfer admits states the specification forbids

curated.text: A transfer whose debit would underflow must be rejected, never allowed to saturate at zero
curated.assertion: value > bal(src) with saturating subtraction credits the full value: supply increases by value - bal(src)

curated.text: An overdrafting transfer must produce no mint witness, so any recorded mint on a transfer path is a defect
curated.assertion: overdraft transfer inflates supply with no legitimate mint event at any declared site

curated.text: A balance read taken before a mutation must not be reused to compute the post-mutation write
curated.assertion: reusing a pre-mutation balance for the second write duplicates the account's value

curated.text: Two credits derived from the same stale balance snapshot must not both be applied
curated.assertion: stale double credit leaves supply short of the sum of the credits: the gap is the lost amount

curated.text: An account balance may not exceed the representable bound unless the chain actually minted that much
curated.assertion: bal(a) at step i <= supply(0) + total minted up to n; exceeding the cap requires a real mint

curated.text: No account may transiently hold more than the chain's cumulative issuance at any intermediate step
curated.assertion: intermediate balances are bounded by initial supply plus cumulative mints, not just final state

curated.text: A burn record must report the requested amount, never the amount a saturating subtraction managed to remove
curated.assertion: unguarded burn reports min(request, balance); the shortfall is invisible in the record

curated.text: A single sufficient-balance guard before the debit must be what makes the burn record and the state agree
curated.assertion: request <= balance is exactly the condition under which reported burn equals applied burn

curated.text: Amounts below the quantization threshold must not be treated as recoverable state
curated.assertion: sub-threshold band collapses to a point: no history is recoverable below the quantum

curated.text: A destroyed account must not be credited again without an explicit re-creation step
curated.assertion: credit applied after erasure has no effect on the erased account and desynchronizes supply

curated.text: Any write to an account already erased in the same transition must be rejected
curated.assertion: write to an erased account is not a state update: the account is absent from the live set

curated.text: The zero-balance precondition for destroying an account must be re-checked after any credit in the same transition
curated.assertion: a credit between the guard check and the erase invalidates the guard

curated.text: Destroying an account must burn exactly its remaining balance and record that amount as the burn
curated.assertion: destroy = zero the balance then erase: burn amount equals the pre-destroy balance

curated.text: The supply reduction on self-destruct must be attributed to zeroing the account, not to the beneficiary transfer
curated.assertion: the transfer alone never burns; only the zeroing step removes supply

curated.text: Skipping state writes on zero-value transfers must not skip the liveness/touch effects the specification requires
curated.assertion: a nonzero-value guard alone does not preserve the liveness component of the state

curated.text: Every balance write must be preceded by a membership check on the account set it writes into
curated.assertion: a write to a non-member account is a no-op or must carry value zero

curated.text: Writing a zero value must not create a storage entry or enlarge the account support
curated.assertion: support after a zero write equals support before it, whatever the write set records

curated.text: Storage presence must be decided by the value being nonzero, never by the key appearing in a write set
curated.assertion: key in storage <-> value at key /= 0; write-set membership is not storage membership

curated.text: Writing the default value into the trie must delete the entry rather than store an explicit default
curated.assertion: trie write of the default value is deletion; a plain map keeping the default is a different algebra

curated.text: The order of the account/storage enumeration must be treated as observable state, not an implementation detail
curated.assertion: two states equal pointwise on balances can still differ in the live-set order

curated.text: Summing two books that share a mirrored account must subtract the mirror balance, or the total overcounts
curated.assertion: naive sum of two ledgers exceeds the true total by exactly the mirrored balance

curated.text: A supply figure must not be used to conclude anything about who holds the value
curated.assertion: moving the entire balance between accounts is supply-neutral and invisible to a supply check

curated.text: A trace whose parity checksum disagrees with the recorded totals must be rejected as corrupt
curated.assertion: no trace exists with a parity inconsistent with its mint/burn totals

curated.text: Event counts must not be used as an accounting invariant: zero-amount events change no total
curated.assertion: a zero-amount mint or burn is a legal record that leaves minted/burned unchanged

curated.text: A zero aggregate credit must be checked to imply zero credit at every individual account
curated.assertion: total credit zero -> per-account credit zero; per-account totals are additive over blocks

curated.text: A site-based audit must be recomputed after any account relabelling, since sites are not rename-invariant
curated.assertion: amounts and counts are rename-blind, but recorded sites move under renaming

curated.text: Appending to a trace must never be assumed neutral: both mint and burn probes are needed to detect it
curated.assertion: every nonempty append is detectable, but only by probing both polarities

curated.text: Account existence must not be inferred from a zero balance: liveness is independent state
curated.assertion: an empty account is not determined by its balance; positivity is the only decidable boundary

curated.text: A withdrawal credit must be recorded as a mint of exactly the credited amount, confined to the recipient
curated.assertion: L.setBal w (bal w + W) -> supply + burned = supply + minted with SiteConfined [w] []

curated.text: A withdrawal to an account not yet in the state must create it before crediting, still as a confined mint
curated.assertion: addLive then credit keeps the mint confined to the recipient and the accounting exact

curated.text: Quantized withdrawal credits must keep total supply an exact multiple of the quantum at every step
curated.assertion: supply n = supply 0 + k * sum of the per-step quanta

curated.text: The destruction phase of a transaction must burn exactly the destroyed balance and confine the burn to that account
curated.assertion: setBal a 0 then eraseLive a -> supply + burn(bal a) balances, SiteConfined [] [a]

curated.text: A sequence of account destructions must reduce supply by exactly the sum of the destroyed balances
curated.assertion: supply n + sum of destroyed balances over range n = supply 0

curated.text: Balance-representation bounds must be justified from cumulative issuance, not assumed per-account
curated.assertion: supply 0 + total minted < W -> every intermediate balance stays below W

curated.text: On a path that declares no mint site, the burn total must account for the entire supply reduction
curated.assertion: SiteConfined [] B trace -> L'.supply + burned trace = L.supply exactly

curated.text: A debit that saturates must surface the shortfall rather than reporting a completed transfer
curated.assertion: saturating debit leaves the shortfall in place: reported movement exceeds actual movement
